name: The Guard Escorts the Man to the Special Elevator
description: A third guard leads a man through a secured facility. They move through corridors with restricted access, passing security checkpoints. The guard guides the man without speaking, proceeding directly to a designated elevator set apart from the others. The man steps inside, followed by the guard, and the doors close.
related_events: Guard leads man to special elevator

name: The Trawler Battles Heavy Seas
description: The trawler cuts through towering waves, its hull shuddering as water crashes over the deck. Spray flies in all directions under the force of the wind, and the vessel leans hard to one side before righting itself, continuing forward through the churning ocean.
related_events: Trawler advances through rough waters

name: Bourne Barricades the Door with a Chair
description: Bourne closes the door behind him and jams a chair under the doorknob, wedging it tightly to keep the door from opening.
related_events: Bourne secures a door by wedging a chair against it

name: Trawler Returns to the Village
description: The trawler approached the small, colorful fishing village and entered the harbor. It slowed as it drew near the dock, its hull cutting through the calm water. The boat came to a stop alongside the wooden pier, where the village awaited its return.
related_events: Trawler arrives at the fishing village

name: Man Doing Chin-Ups on Deck Rail While Injured
description: The man stands on the deck, gripping the rail above him. His body is bandaged, fresh wounds visible beneath the wrappings. He pulls himself up, arms trembling as he completes a chin-up. He lowers himself slowly, then rises again. Each repetition strains his injured frame, but he continues, one after another, breathing hard, sweat mixing with the blood seeping through the bandages.
related_events: Man performs chin-ups on deck rail despite injuries

name: Panic in the Lobby as Marines Rush In
description: People suddenly bolt from the lobby, scrambling in all directions as shouts echo through the space. Amid the chaos, a group of Marines bursts through the exterior doors, moving quickly into the building as others continue to flee.
related_events: People flee the lobby in panic
Additional Marines enter the building from outside

name: Three Marines Ascend Stairs in Tactical Formation
description: Three armed marines move up a staircase in a coordinated leapfrog pattern. One marine advances while the other two cover, then the next moves forward while the others provide overwatch. They progress step by step, weapons aimed ahead, scanning for threats as they climb.
related_events: Three marines initiate a point-to-point assault up the stairs

name: Security Chief and Marines Push Through Crowd
description: The Security Chief, flanked by five Marines, surges upward, shoving past people who are moving in the opposite direction. The group advances quickly, forcing their way through the crowd without stopping.
related_events: Security Chief and five Marines rush up while pushing past people

name: Buy a One-Way Ticket at the Window
description: The Man stands at the ticket window and speaks with the Ticket Agent. He says, 'Una sola via?' The agent responds, 'Una sola via?' He replies, 'Si. One way. Una sola via.'
related_events: The Man purchases a one-way ticket
related_occasions: Ticket Window Transaction

name: Security Chief and Marines Descend Stairs Amid Chaos
description: The security chief leads a team of marines down the main stairs, weapons drawn. They move through a scene of pandemonium, pushing forward amid the disorder, their path marked by tension and the visible readiness for confrontation.
related_events: Security chief and marines advance through chaos with weapons drawn

name: Bourne Approaches the Facility Gates
description: Bourne walks toward the entrance of a heavily guarded facility. Large gates stand closed, with speed barricades in place. U.S. Marines patrol the area near a gatehouse, and an American flag flaps in the wind. People move in and out, and Bourne follows the flow, approaching the checkpoint without drawing attention.
related_events: Bourne approaches secured facility entrance under guard

name: Buy a Slice of Pizza
description: The man walks through the terminal and passes a pizza place that is closing for the night. He checks his funds and finds just enough for one cold slice. He buys the slice from the counter.
related_events: The man checks his available funds
The man buys a cold slice of pizza

name: Man Inquires About Numbered Account at Bank
description: A man enters the bank and approaches the receptionist. He states he is there about a numbered account. The receptionist nods, picks up a pen and a bank card, and hands them to him, indicating he should enter his account number. The man takes the pen and begins to write.
related_events: Man arrives at bank to inquire about a numbered account
Receptionist requests account number from the man
Man accepts pen to input account number

name: Man Attempts to Use Old Espresso Machine and It Explodes
description: A man stands in front of a ratty old espresso machine, silently studying it. He begins to work with it, carefully packing ground coffee into the portafilter and forcing it into place. He secures the machine, reaches for the controls, and turns on the steam. A moment later, the machine shudders, then violently explodes, sending steam and debris outward. The machine lies in ruins, no longer functional.
related_events: Man attempts to operate old espresso machine
Espresso machine explodes during use

name: Attendees Evacuate During Trade Conference Alarm
description: The alarm blares suddenly inside the conference hall. Sixty people jolt from their seats, pushing toward the doors. Papers scatter, chairs scrape against the floor, and voices rise in overlapping shouts. The crowd surges into the corridor, pressing forward in a tight stream, hands on railings, eyes darting toward exits.
related_events: Alarm triggers widespread confusion and evacuation
related_occasions: Trade Conference

name: The Man Casts a Line into the Dark Sea
description: The Man stands at the rail, staring out over the water. He turns away and notices a surfcasting rod propped against a locker. He picks it up, flips the bail, traps the line, and casts it far out into the darkness. As the line sails through the air, he smiles.
related_events: The Man picks up a surfcasting rod and begins casting into the sea
The Man smiles for the first time while casting into the darkness

name: Bourne Escapes as Alarm Blares
description: Bourne climbs the stairs two and three at a time, moving fast upward. A security alarm screams behind him—bleet, bleet, bleet—filling the air with sharp, urgent warnings.
related_events: Bourne ascends stairs rapidly during security alarm
Security alarm activates and emits repeated warning sounds

name: Bourne Enters the Prep Area
description: Bourne bursts through a door into a butler's prep area just off the main conference room. The space is empty—no people, no movement. Tables hold only tablecloths, silverware, and coffee cups. He slows for a moment, taking in the stillness.
related_events: Bourne enters butler's prep area abruptly
Bourne finds prep area empty

name: Bourne bursts into dead-end corridor and climbs stairs
description: Bourne slams through a door into a narrow corridor, scans the space, and sees no exit except a staircase leading upward. He immediately runs toward the stairs and starts climbing.
related_events: Bourne bursts through the door into a dead-end corridor
Bourne discovers there is no escape except up the stairs

name: Zorn Chases Conklin Down Staircase, Confronts Him About Account Access
description: Conklin races down a staircase, footsteps echoing as Zorn chases close behind. As they descend, Zorn calls out, demanding to know if it was Conklin who accessed the account. Conklin asks if they're certain. Zorn confirms it—Conklin was the one who accessed the account. The pursuit continues, the sound of their steps fading into the distance.
related_events: Conklin races down a staircase while Zorn chases after him
Zorn confirms Conklin accessed the account

name: The Man and His Reflection in the Darkening Train
description: The man turns to the train window and looks at his reflection. Around him, people go about their quiet routines—families, businessmen, ordinary travelers. His face is still, fixed in the glass. The train surges forward, then enters a tunnel. Darkness floods the cabin, swallowing the light, and his reflection vanishes.
related_events: The man observes his reflection in the train window
Train enters tunnel plunging cabin into darkness

name: The Bandaged Man Hauls Nets with Sailors
description: The man, his body still marked with bandages, stands among the sailors on the deck, gripping the coarse ropes of the fishing nets. He pulls in rhythm with the crew, straining as they drag the heavy nets from the sea. Salt spray clings to his skin, and his movements, though careful, are steady. The sailors glance his way but say nothing, accepting his labor as part of the day’s work. Together, they coil the wet nets, the sea wind tugging at their clothes.
related_events: Injured man works alongside sailors
Sailors haul in fishing nets

name: Giancarlo Gives Money and Says Goodbye
description: The man finishes buttoning up the borrowed clothes. Giancarlo pulls some cash from his pocket and offers it. The man takes it and says he won’t forget this. Giancarlo looks at him, shakes his head slightly, and says nothing.
related_events: Giancarlo offers money to the man
The man expresses gratitude for Giancarlo's help
Giancarlo silently reacts to the man's gratitude

name: The Man Meets Mr. Apfel at the Elevator
description: The elevator doors open and The Man steps out. Mr. Apfel, a banker from Zurich, stands waiting. He greets The Man and says, 'Good morning, sir. I assume you're here about your box.' The Man hesitates, then replies, '...yes...' Mr. Apfel nods and gestures down the corridor.
related_events: The Man exits the elevator
Mr. Apfel greets The Man and mentions the box
Mr. Apfel gestures toward the corridor

name: Nighttime Corpse Recovery on Fishing Trawler
description: A searchlight cuts across the heaving ocean swells in the darkness. On the deck of an aging fishing trawler, half a dozen fishermen move quickly, their flashlights sweeping the water. They cluster at the railing, peering into the waves. One spots something and calls out. A gaff is brought forward. The men lean over the side, reaching into the water, struggling to hook the shape beneath the surface. After a moment, they pull a human corpse from the sea and onto the deck.
related_events: Searchlight scans ocean swells during nighttime operation
Fishermen use flashlights to locate corpse in water
Fishermen attempt to retrieve corpse with gaff

name: Return the Box and Recall the Last Visit
description: Bourne hands the box back to the deposit guard. He pauses and says he's trying to remember how long it's been since he was there. The guard replies that it must have been about three weeks.
related_events: Bourne returns deposit box to deposit guard
Bourne reflects on time since last visit
Deposit guard estimates duration since last visit

name: Bourne Enters Restricted Hallway, Bureaucrat Reacts
description: Jason Bourne moves quickly down a carpeted hallway lined with offices, entering a restricted area. Bureaucrats inside the offices notice his presence. One steps out and asks, 'Excuse me? Can I help you?' as he backs away. Bourne continues forward without stopping.
related_events: Bourne enters restricted office hallway rapidly
Bureaucrat questions Bourne while retreating

name: The Man and the Cracked Mirror
description: The man stands in a run-down bathroom before a pitted, tarnished mirror, staring at his reflection. Beads of sweat form on his forehead. He speaks in perfect French, asking if anyone knows who he is. He blinks, then wipes the sweat from his face. Switching to perfect Dutch, he demands to be told who he is, pleading for an answer. His face remains the only response.
related_events: The man speaks in perfect French while staring at his reflection
The man speaks in perfect Dutch while wiping perspiration from his forehead

name: Bourne Directs Crowd to Backstairs During Evacuation
description: The alarm blares inside the building as people surge toward the main stairway, shouting over one another. Embassy staff and trade workers push together in confusion, blocking the exit. From somewhere off to the side, a voice shouts, 'No! The other way! Take the backstairs! He's on the other side — there's a bomb!' The crowd freezes for a split second, then surges backward, scrambling away from the main stairs. The man who yelled is Jason Bourne, now visible in the chaos, watching the flow of people shift toward the rear exit.
related_events: Bourne shouts evacuation instructions to the crowd
Crowd panics due to bomb warning during evacuation
related_occasions: Emergency Evacuation At Diplomatic Building

name: Man Submits Hand Scan at High-Security Bank
description: The man stands before a biometric scanner in a high-security bank. Two guards watch closely as one of them instructs him to provide a hand scan. He places his palm onto the mirrored surface. For a brief moment, his reflection glimmers beneath him. A wave of white light passes under his hand as the scanner activates.
related_events: Bank guard instructs man to provide hand scan
Man places hand on biometric scanner
Man sees his reflection in scanning surface before activation
Biometric scanner activates with white light

name: Placing the First Piece
description: The man hesitates, then reaches into the box and takes out a black knight. He holds it for a moment before placing it on the chess board. One by one, he begins setting up the other pieces, his movements growing quicker.
related_events: The man selects a black knight from the box
The man places the black knight on the chess board

name: The Man Sets Up the Chess Pieces
description: The man places the black knight on the board and begins setting up the remaining pieces. He moves quickly, placing each piece in position, his hands moving with increasing speed and certainty.
related_events: The man rapidly sets up the chess pieces

name: Zorn Delivers Abbott's Message to Conklin
description: Zorn moves quickly through the operations suite, passing technicians at their stations. He reaches Conklin's small office at the back and steps inside. Conklin looks up from the work on his desk, where a cot is tucked in the corner. Zorn tells him that Abbott wants to talk. Conklin replies that they are busy and tells Zorn to inform Abbott of that. Zorn responds that he already tried, but was unable to put Abbott off.
related_events: Zorn moves quickly through the operations suite toward Conklin's office
Zorn informs Conklin that Abbott wants to talk
Conklin looks up from his work and responds to Zorn
Zorn reports his unsuccessful attempt to defer Abbott
related_occasions: Operations Center Activity At Langley Facility

name: Security Chief Orders Evacuation Amid Armed Intruder Threat
description: The Security Chief, flanked by three Marines with sidearms drawn, jogs rapidly past the inner offices. A deputy DCM in a suit runs alongside, demanding an explanation. The Security Chief shouts orders to evacuate the building immediately. The deputy protests, pointing out that a trade meeting is underway. The Security Chief insists, yelling to call the code and get everyone out, explaining that an armed suspect—fleeing from police and carrying an unknown item—is inside the building, and his location is unknown.
related_events: Security Chief initiates building evacuation due to armed suspect
Three Marines assist in emergency evacuation with sidearms drawn
related_occasions: Trade Meeting At Diplomatic Compound

name: Deputy DCM Refuses Evacuation Amid Security Alert
description: The Security Chief and three Marines jog past the inner offices, sidearms drawn, urging everyone to evacuate. A frantic Deputy DCM runs beside them, protesting that they are in the middle of a trade meeting. The Security Chief insists the order stands, shouting to call the code and get all personnel out. The Deputy DCM demands more information, and the Security Chief explains that an individual is fleeing from police, carrying a bag of unknown contents, and is currently inside the building.
related_events: Deputy DCM protests evacuation during ongoing trade meeting
related_occasions: Trade Meeting At Diplomatic Compound

name: Marines Confront Trade People on Fifth Floor
description: The assault marines continue climbing the stairwell, weapons ready, when the fifth-floor door suddenly flies open. The lead marine shouts 'Halt!' and the team stops instantly. Marines swing their guns up, fingers tense on the triggers. Trade people appear in the doorway, screaming. The marines yell for them to get down. The alarm blares continuously, filling the stairwell with noise as both groups react to the sudden encounter.
related_events: Fifth floor door flies open during marine ascent
Lead Marine commands halt to advancing force
Marines raise weapons and prepare to fire
Marines yell for trade people to get down
Trade people begin screaming upon encountering marines
Alarm blares through stairwell during confrontation

name: The Man Approaches Gemeinschaft Bank
description: The man stood in the shadows across from Gemeinschaft Bank, scanning the street. He checked for police, for any sign of trouble. The coast clear, he stepped from the shadows and walked toward the bank.
related_events: The man observes the street for police and potential threats
The man begins walking toward the bank

name: Guards Unlock Bank Door
description: Morning light spreads across the financial district. Two guards stand at the entrance of Gemeinschaft Bank, keys in hand. They unlock the heavy front door, step inside, and prepare the lobby for the day’s business.
related_events: Two guards unlock the front door of Gemeinschaft Bank

name: Sailors Find a Body on the Deck
description: The sailors came upon a still figure lying on the deck. They began talking at once, voices overlapping in different languages, their words quick and sharp. One of them reached out and nudged the body with his foot. Another protested, telling him to stop. The first sailor scoffed, saying the dead man wouldn’t care. Before the argument could go further, the body twitched. It convulsed suddenly, coughing up seawater. The men froze, then jumped back, staring as the man drew in a ragged breath.
related_events: Sailors discover a body on the deck
One sailor nudges the body with his foot

name: The Man Comes Back to Life
description: The body lies still, surrounded by sailors who speak over one another in startled voices, some nudging the corpse. One points out a gunshot wound. As they argue about respect, the body suddenly jerks, convulses violently, and coughs up seawater. The sailors cry out, stumbling backward in alarm. The man draws breath, his chest rising and falling as the others stand frozen, staring.
related_events: The man coughs up seawater and begins breathing

name: Wombosi's Defiant Warning and the CIA Briefing
description: Marshall stands at the head of a conference table in a dimly lit room, remote in hand. He plays a video clip for a group of CIA officials seated around the table. The screen shows Nykwana Wombosi, a former African dictator, seated in a lavish throne room surrounded by bodyguards and a translator. Wombosi speaks in English, his voice firm and agitated. He denies that the time is right for action, warns that his enemies are too strong, and threatens those who believe his power has weakened. He claims he will reveal evidence in due time and promises that his old friends will hear from him. The image freezes on his intense stare. Marshall stops the tape and identifies the footage as a recent interview recorded in Paris, broadcast by a German television station in Dresden. He explains that Wombosi has a history of using European media to send messages to the CIA, often implying he possesses damaging information about the Agency’s activities in Africa. Marshall notes that in this particular interview, Wombosi alleges he has survived an assassination attempt orchestrated by the CIA and claims to have proof. He asks the room whether there is any truth to the accusation. The officials remain silent. No one raises a hand.
related_events: Wombosi delivers defiant statement in news interview
Marshall presents Wombosi's interview footage at briefing
related_occasions: Cia Briefing Session On Nykwana Wombosi

name: Marshall Discloses Wombosi's Assassination Claim
description: Marshall stands before a group of CIA officials gathered in a briefing room. He informs them that Nykwana Wombosi, during a recent interview with a German television station, has publicly accused the CIA of attempting to assassinate him. Wombosi states he possesses proof of the plot. Marshall plays a clip of the interview, in which Wombosi speaks angrily, warning his enemies and claiming the time is not yet right for full exposure. After the footage ends, Marshall addresses the room, noting the serious consequences if Wombosi's allegations gain credibility. He asks whether there is any truth to the claim. The officials sit in silence. No one speaks or raises a hand. The room remains still.
related_events: Marshall reveals Wombosi's claim of assassination attempt by Cia
Cia officials remain silent on Wombosi's assassination allegation
related_occasions: Cia Briefing Session On Nykwana Wombosi

name: Abbott Questions Conklin About Marseille and Treadstone
description: Abbott meets with Conklin over coffee, noting the approaching storm and commenting on the weather. He brings up Marseille and Nykwana Wombosi, then asks Conklin directly if the operation there was connected to Treadstone. Conklin responds with surprise, acknowledging that Abbott has never asked such a direct question before. Abbott confirms he is asking, and Conklin falls silent. Abbott mentions that an agency oversight committee is being formed and will review budgets, including Treadstone’s significant funding. He asks what he should do. Conklin advises him to downplay Treadstone as a theoretical training program and sign off on that explanation. When Abbott asks what to do if he cannot do that, Conklin replies that he would then have to explain Treadstone, and Abbott would have to explain how he allowed it to proceed so far. After a pause, Conklin tells Abbott they will clean up the field operations if Abbott handles the budget issues.
related_events: Abbott confronts Conklin about Treadstone's involvement in Marseille
Conklin reacts to Abbott's direct inquiry about Treadstone

name: Abbott and Conklin Confront Oversight Threat to Treadstone
description: Abbott tells Conklin that an agency oversight committee is being formed to review budgets, and that Treadstone represents a significant line item that could draw unwanted attention. Conklin responds by suggesting Abbott describe Treadstone as a training program with only theoretical applications. He advises Abbott to sign off on that explanation to prevent further inquiry. When Abbott asks what to do if he cannot do that, Conklin says he would then have to explain Treadstone’s true nature, and Abbott would have to explain his role in allowing it to expand unchecked. The two agree on a plan: Conklin will handle the situation in the field, and Abbott will manage the budget concerns on his end.
related_events: Abbott expresses concern about agency oversight committee reviewing Treadstone budget
Conklin advises Abbott on how to downplay Treadstone's significance

name: Abbott and Conklin Secure Treadstone from Oversight
description: Storm clouds gathered overhead as Abbott approached Conklin, warning of an impending agency oversight committee that would scrutinize budgets, including Treadstone's significant expenditures. Abbott pressed Conklin directly, asking if the incident in Marseille was connected to Treadstone. Conklin noted the rarity of such a direct question, then responded with silence. Abbott pressed further, asking what he should do about the scrutiny. Conklin suggested downplaying Treadstone as a theoretical training program and signing off on that explanation. When Abbott questioned what would happen if he couldn't do that, Conklin warned he would have to explain Treadstone—and Abbott would have to explain how he allowed it to expand so far. The two men exchanged a long silence. Conklin then stated they would clean up the field operations while Abbott handled the budget issues.
related_events: Conklin threatens to expose Treadstone and Abbott's complicity if pressured
Abbott and Conklin agree on mutual cleanup efforts to protect Treadstone

name: Clearing Space, Finding the Kit
description: The sailors swept debris off a table and laid the injured man down. Giancarlo, hands rough and eyes bloodshot, moved quickly through the clutter, searching for the medical kit. He found it buried in an old trunk, pried it open, and pulled out the supplies. The captain stood in the doorway, watching. We pick him up, he said. That’s as far as it goes. Giancarlo nodded. The crew scattered back to work. He took a quick pull from a hidden pint of rum and turned back to the man on the table.
related_events: Sailors clear table to make space for injured man
Giancarlo searches for buried medical kit
Giancarlo finds medical kit in old trunk

name: Captain Halts Medical Efforts and Resumes Mission
description: The Captain stands in the doorway, watching as Giancarlo searches through the wreckage. Giancarlo finds a medical kit and opens an old trunk, muttering that help is coming, urging someone to bring blankets. The Captain calls out, 'We pick him up? Okay, we have to pick him up. But that's as far as it goes.' Giancarlo insists the man needs a doctor. The Captain responds, 'Fuck that. He lives? He dies? I don't care. We've wasted two hours on this shit already. You do what you can, but we're not going back.' His voice turns hard. 'You understand me?' Giancarlo says, 'Yes, sir.' The Captain turns to the others. 'Let's get back to work!' The sailors rush out. Giancarlo watches them leave, then takes a quick drink from a hidden pint of rum.
related_events: Captain instructs team to lift injured man
Captain refuses to prioritize injured man's survival
Giancarlo complies with Captain's order
Captain commands team to resume work

name: Giancarlo Takes a Drink After the Crew Leaves
description: The crew runs out, returning to work. Giancarlo stays behind, watching them go. He reaches for a hidden pint of rum, takes a quick pull, then sets it down again.
related_events: Giancarlo takes secret drink from hidden rum stash

name: Marie Kreutz Confronts Consulate Clerk Over Visa Application
description: Marie Kreutz stands at a consulate cubicle, speaking urgently to a clerk. She explains that her apartment is gone, she has no current address, and her visa application is stalled. Her voice rises as she insists she provided all required documents. The clerk interrupts, stating she entered into a fraudulent marriage to bypass U.S. immigration laws. Marie responds that she only knows this because she disclosed it herself. She flips through papers, pulling out a form, and points to the name Mr. Thomas, saying she told him everything last week. She admits she paid four thousand dollars to a man to marry her, money she can’t afford to lose, and emphasizes that she didn’t know he was already married. She demands to know why she’s being punished when she’s the victim. The clerk remains impassive, then asks if she is now applying for a student visa. Marie stops speaking, caught off guard by the shift in question.
related_events: Marie Kreutz argues with consulate clerk over lost apartment and visa status
Marie Kreutz reveals she paid four thousand dollars to a man for a sham marriage
Marie Kreutz identifies Mr. Thomas as the case officer who received her full confession
Marie Kreutz confronts consulate clerk about her fraudulent marriage disclosure
Consulate clerk informs Marie Kreutz that her past disclosure does not change her current visa issue
related_occasions: Passport And Visa Office Processing Day

name: Bourne Waits in Line at the Consulate
description: Jason Bourne stands in the U.S. citizens line at the passport and visa office. The room is large, windowless, and crowded with people. Around him, consulate clerks sit in open cubicles, handling requests from tourists, visa applicants, and asylum seekers. Bourne remains quiet, his expression focused as he recalls recent events—the police outside, a confrontation in the park, and an incident at a bank. He waits, thinking carefully about what he will say when it's his turn.
related_events: Jason Bourne waits in the U.S. citizens line while reflecting on recent incidents
related_occasions: Passport And Visa Office Processing Day

name: Clerk Questions Marie's Student Visa Application
description: Marie Kreutz stood at the consulate counter, papers in hand, her voice rising as she recounted how she had paid four thousand dollars to a man who lied about being unmarried. She emphasized that she had disclosed the fraudulent marriage to the case officer, Mr. Thomas, the week before. The clerk repeated her name, asking her to keep her voice down, then interrupted the flow of her argument by posing a new question: was she now applying for a student visa? Marie fell silent, caught off guard by the shift in direction. The clerk waited, the paperwork on the counter between them.
related_events: Consulate clerk shifts focus to Marie Kreutz's new application for a student visa
related_occasions: Passport And Visa Office Processing Day

name: Bourne at the Immigration Counter
description: Bourne stands in line at the immigration counter, scanning the room. A Turkish man pleads with a desk clerk, close to tears as he tries to explain his situation. Nearby, two American backpackers tell a clerk they’ve lost their passports. A security camera looms high on the wall, rotating slightly. The woman behind the window calls Bourne forward. He hesitates, then approaches. She asks if he’s a U.S. citizen. He says yes, then corrects himself, saying he thinks so. She asks if he has his passport. He says he has one, but it’s complicated. She repeats the question. He doesn’t answer, turns away, and walks out.
related_events: Bourne observes chaotic scene at immigration counter
Turkish man struggles to explain case to desk clerk
American backpackers report lost passports

name: Bourne Called to Counter Amid Rising Panic
description: The clerk calls out that it's Bourne's turn, waving him forward. He snaps back to the moment, heart racing. His eyes dart around the room—the Turkish man pleading at the desk, the backpackers arguing about lost documents, the security camera watching from above. He steps toward the window, but his mind blanks. The clerk asks if he's a U.S. citizen. He hesitates, then answers uncertainly. When she asks for his passport, he falters, muttering that it's complicated. Before she can respond, he turns away, leaving the bag behind, and walks quickly out of the room.
related_events: Clerk signals Bourne to approach window
Bourne experiences moment of panic before approaching counter

name: Bourne questioned at passport counter
description: The woman clerk asks Bourne if he is a U.S. citizen. He pauses, then says yes, but hesitates and corrects himself, saying he thinks so. She presses him, demanding a definite answer. He confirms he is, but stammers when she asks for his passport. He says he has one, but it's complicated. She repeats the question, and he falters, unable to produce the document. He looks around, then turns away from the counter and walks out of the room.
related_events: Woman clerk questions Bourne about U.S. citizenship and passport
Bourne hesitates and stammers during passport inquiry

name: Bourne Leaves the Immigration Counter
description: Bourne stands at the immigration window, the clerk waiting for an answer. He hesitates, then steps back. Without speaking, he turns away from the counter, moves quickly through the room, and exits, leaving the line and the clerk behind.
related_events: Bourne decides to abandon interaction and leaves immigration counter

name: The Man Tests His Mind
description: The man sits up on the bed, bandages wrapped around his body. He looks at a sign on the door and reads it aloud. He begins to count, then speaks to himself, testing each word as it comes. His voice is low, tense. He turns to Giancarlo, who is bent over a small plastic tube taken from his hip, and asks what he is doing. Giancarlo finds a magnifying glass and examines a fragment from the tube. Under the lens, numbers and letters appear: 000-7-17-12-0-14-26. GEMEINSCHAFT BANK, ZURICH. Giancarlo tells the man it came from under his skin, that he has a bank in Zurich. The man stares. He says he doesn’t remember Zurich. Giancarlo looks at him, then offers a bottle of rum. The man says he doesn’t know if he drinks rum.
related_events: The man expresses fear about memory loss
The man demonstrates cognitive functions by reading and counting

name: Giancarlo Inspects the Implant from the Man's Hip
description: Giancarlo hunches over a desk, using tweezers and a flashlight to work on a strange plastic tube removed from the man's hip. The man sits up on the bed, bandaged and uneasy, watching silently. Giancarlo rummages through a drawer and pulls out a magnifying glass. He holds a small fragment of the tube under the lens. Under magnification, a sequence of numbers and letters becomes visible: 000-7-17-12-0-14-26. Beneath it, the words GEMEINSCHAFT BANK, ZURICH. Giancarlo turns to the man and tells him the tube came from under his skin. The man stares, uncomprehending. Giancarlo asks if he remembers Zurich. He says no. Giancarlo takes a drink from a pint bottle and offers it to him, asking if he drinks rum. The man says he doesn't know.
related_events: Giancarlo examines plastic tube extracted from the man's hip
Giancarlo retrieves a magnifying glass to examine the tube

name: Confrontation in the Park
description: Two Zurich police officers approach a man lying on a bench in a closed park. They order him to stand, telling him the park is closed and sleeping is not allowed. When they demand identification, the man says his papers are lost. The officers insist, drawing a nightstick and ordering him to raise his hands. The man complies slowly, protesting that he only wants to sleep. As one officer moves in to pat him down, the man resists, speaking in German to explain he just needs rest. The second officer prods him sharply in the back with the nightstick. The man reacts instantly, spinning and striking the officer in the throat. Before the first officer can draw his weapon, the man sweeps his legs out, sending him crashing into the bench. He delivers three rapid punches, knocking the officer unconscious. The second officer writhes on the ground, struggling to reach his holster. The man steps down hard on his arm, breaking it, then grabs the officer's pistol. He presses the gun to the officer's forehead, pauses, then strikes him in the temple with the weapon. The man stands over the two fallen officers, blood on his clothes. He looks at the gun in his hand, examines it briefly, then drops it and runs into the darkness.

Giancarlo probes the wounds with focused precision, flashlight clenched between his teeth, the metallic chime of fragments dropping into an olive jar echoing in the room. He turns the man onto his side, examining the injuries closely. Then, something catches his eye—a scar on the man’s hip. He takes an exacto knife, cuts into the flesh, and with tweezers pulls out a small plastic tube. As it comes free, the man’s hand suddenly clamps down on Giancarlo’s. The man’s eyes open. He blinks up at Giancarlo, disoriented. Giancarlo speaks, calm but firm. The man asks where he is. Giancarlo tells him he’s on an Italian fishing boat near Vietri, that he was pulled from the water, that the cold saved him. The man asks how he got there. Giancarlo says he was found lost at sea. description: Bourne moves quickly through the lobby, scanning for a way out. Zurich police are gathered outside near the entry gate, and marines guard the building's interior access points, each station equipped with metal detectors. He heads for the larger of the two entry gates, the one farthest from the front door and the passport office, where a line of people waits to be screened. Three marines check bags and direct individuals through the security checkpoint. As Bourne approaches, the Security Chief calls out from across the lobby, ordering someone with a red bag to stop. A marine behind Bourne raises his M-16. Bourne begins to comply, then suddenly swings his backpack, striking the marine. He vaults over the metal detector, pulling one of the people in line toward him to block his back. Another marine lunges, and Bourne kicks him hard, the impact breaking the man’s arm. The Security Chief shouts not to fire as two other marines raise their weapons. Bourne lands on the first marine, rolls away, grabs the M-16, and comes to his feet inside the building. Someone screams that he has a gun. He swings the weapon as people scatter, then sprints down a hallway, discarding the rifle as he runs deeper into the building. The Security Chief speaks frantically into his radio, calling a code red and reporting a male suspect, five-ten, brown hair, black jacket, red bag, last seen heading for the south side entrance.
